claims.claim: In 2024, 2,266 unique MAID practitioners; a small set (n=102) accounted for 38.0% of Track 1 and 27.2% of Track 2 provisions. Vast majority of that set did fewer than 11 Track 2; none did more than 20 Track 2.
Quebec CSFV reports nearly all MAID compliant with LCSFV (99.7% in recent annuals); noncompliant share ~0.3%. 2024-25: 6,268 MAID = 7.9% of Quebec deaths.
claims.honest_edge: Commission self-audit after provider reports — not police prosecutions

claims.claim: BC MAID Oversight Unit FOI/internal 2024 report (via National Post / CCN): of cases reviewed, 51.9% required follow-up with 2,807 total errors; 353 cases (12.5%) triggered practitioner/pharmacist education on legal/professional standards. Unit reviews paperwork; does not itself investigate misconduct.
claims.honest_edge: Most follow-up clerical; serious share cited by ministry as 0.2% since 2018

claims.claim: Earlier BC FOI (to Nov 2023): ~22 referrals to regulatory colleges and 2 referrals to law enforcement since 2018 (Criminal Code s.241.2 concerns).
claims.source_secondary: Canadian Catholic News / FOI HTH-2023-31879 reporting
claims.note: Illustrative historic FOI tally — ministry later withheld fresh referral counts citing privacy
